svg.metadata: General Program roadmap: a new content-method-indicator matrix layout of Changqing Xu's public 2003 CaSR proposal text, award 30370577. Layout inspired by the BioSoph template in the XJTU library publication PDF page 6. Organ, cell and molecular evidence remain parallel, with no new cross-validation steps. No source artwork copied. Research aims are not established findings. See references/mianshang-layouts.md and references/funded-cases.md. Multicolor module variant; explicit flat fills with black outlines and arrows. Layout and text unchanged.
